contents.text: <instructions>Which word matches the picture?</instructions>

When two letters come together to make one vowel sound, they are called a vowel digraph. Sometimes vowel digraphs create a sound called a diphthong. You can feel your mouth move when you say a diphthong, so diphthongs may feel as though they have two sounds.

header.text: The diphthongs oi and oy make the same vowel sound. At the beginning of a word or in the middle of a word, the oi spelling is usually used. At the end of a word, the oy spelling is used.

The diphthongs ou and ow can also make the same vowel sound. At the beginning of a word or in the middle of a word, you have to remember which spelling to use. At the end of a word, only the ow spelling is used.
